blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Five-month-old puppy Tirik, dragged along the San Pascual-Bauan road while tethered to a moving tricycle, is now safe, the Animal Kingdom Foundation (AKF) said. In a viral video posted on social media, Tirik was seen being pulled by a tricycle, with his leash attached to the vehicle. According to AKF, the tricycle driver, who was also Tirik’s owner, was unaware that the puppy had fallen off the vehicle.
